rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a material structural template for the child letter: both respond favorably to a House committee's revision of Administration legislation, state that the committee bill substantially follows or addresses the President's recommendations, identify particular provisions needing adjustment, and close by supporting enactment of the overall measure. C06 and C10 share education or legislative-endorsement language, but their drafting structures are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am pleased, of course, with your report that the Committee has approved many provisions which generally follow the recommendations I made last January.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: First, on the whole the bill clearly reflects constructive efforts... Second, by and large the bill seems to deal positively with every major problem I presented to the Congress.
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by approving a committee revision because it substantially carries forward the President's earlier legislative recommendations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I do suggest, however, that the addition of this provision should lessen the need for scholarships. I hope, as the bill progresses, that adjustments will be made to reduce the number of scholarships.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Third, in certain respects--two quite important--I believe that changes would make the Committee's revision clearer... I hope this language will be suitably adjusted on the House floor.
shared_material.explanation: Both pivot from general approval to a small number of requested changes and express hope that the bill will be adjusted during subsequent House consideration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The passage of a sound educational bill is a top-priority objective for this session of Congress and I heartily support your efforts to achieve this objective.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I congratulate you and your Committee colleagues for the progress made toward developing a sound defense structure.
shared_material.explanation: Both preserve an affirmative, cooperative tone toward the committee while requesting revisions to an otherwise sound measure.
